user.title: Connect to NeoHub
user.description: Configure your NeoHub connection to integrate DSC Neo alarm panels.

hassio_confirm.title: NeoHub Discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The NeoHub add-on was discovered at {host}:{port}. Do you want to set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to NeoHub. Check the host and port.

fap_not_available.message: NeoHub does not offer FAP commands (NeoHub not connected, an older NeoHub, or FAP commands disabled in the NeoHub settings); nothing was sent

fap_one_entity.message: Select exactly one DSC Neo alarm panel entity (entity_id) for the FAP command; nothing was sent

fap_invalid_keys.message: The FAP command does not accept {keys}: select exactly one alarm panel entity with entity_id; nothing was sent

fap_unknown_entity.message: {entity_id} is not an enabled alarm panel entity of a loaded DSC Neo integration entry; nothing was sent

fap_invalid_type.message: The FAP type must be fire, auxiliary or panic; nothing was sent

fap_not_confirmed.message: Set confirm to true to send the FAP command, which reports a real alarm to the monitoring station; nothing was sent

arm_home_instant.name: Arm home (instant)
arm_home_instant.description: Arms the partition in Stay mode with no entry delay (Stay Instant). The partition shows as Armed Home.

code.name: Code
code.description: Access code. Leave empty to use the entity's default code if one is set in Home Assistant, otherwise NeoHub's default access code.

arm_away_instant.name: Arm away (instant)
arm_away_instant.description: Arms the partition in Away mode with no entry delay (Away Instant). The partition shows as Armed Away.

code.name: Code
code.description: Access code. Leave empty to use the entity's default code if one is set in Home Assistant, otherwise NeoHub's default access code.

activate_fap.name: Activate FAP alarm (experimental)
activate_fap.description: WARNING: triggers a REAL alarm. Sends a Fire, Auxiliary or Panic alarm for one partition, like the F, A and P keys on the keypad; the panel reports it to the monitoring station. Experimental and untested on a real panel. Needs FAP commands enabled in the NeoHub settings. Sent once, never retried.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: The one alarm panel entity (partition) to send the alarm for.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on (true) to send: confirms that a real alarm is reported to the monitoring station.
